shadows.name: mascot-offset-v3
shadows.purpose: 首頁吉祥物透明底輪廓陰影（唯一 drop-shadow 例外，即 --deep 14% 取樣）

shadows.name: mascot-offset-base
shadows.purpose: 吉祥物基礎規則陰影（--deep 11% 取樣，V3 覆寫後不可見）

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: 按鈕浮起與按壓的彈性緩動

components.name: 主按鈕
components.description: 鍋湯深紅底主行動按鈕
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #8e2428; color: #fffdf7; border: 2px solid #8e2428; padding: 15px 23px; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; transition: transform .2s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), box-shadow .2s; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { transform: translate(-2px,-2px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #382620; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translate(2px,2px); box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #382620; }

components.name: 描邊按鈕
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; border: 2px solid currentColor; padding: 15px 23px; font-weight: 800; color: #8e2428; background: #fffdf7; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { transform: translate(-2px,-2px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #382620; }

components.name: 頁首 CTA
components.css: .ds-header-cta { border: 2px solid #8e2428; color: #8e2428; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 900; padding: 12px 19px; border-radius: 4px; background: #fffdf7; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; display: inline-block; } .ds-header-cta:hover { transform: translate(-2px,-2px); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #382620; }

components.name: 鍋物卡片
components.css: .ds-card-pot { border: 2px solid #382620; background: #fffdf7; padding: 24px 23px 30px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; } .ds-card-pot h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 900; color: #622027; } .ds-card-pot p { margin: 0; line-height: 1.9; font-size: 15px; color: #382620; }

components.name: 菜單徽章
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #f4cb5a; border: 2px solid #382620; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #382620; color: #622027; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 900; letter-spacing: .5px; line-height: 1.4; padding: 3px 10px; transform: rotate(-1deg); font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; }

components.name: 營業狀態
components.css: .ds-open-now { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; border: 2px solid #382620; box-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #382620; background: #fffdf7; color: #622027; padding: 9px 16px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 800; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; } .ds-dot { width: 10px; height: 10px; border-radius: 50%; background: #4f9d69; display: inline-block; }

components.name: 主導覽
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 26px; font-family: 'Noto Sans TC', sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; color: #382620; text-decoration: none; padding: 12px 4px; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #8e2428; }

narrative.overview: 奶油紙底、粗黑描邊、深紅標題、芥末黃貼紙，30 秒內回答價錢、停車與營業時間。不用漸層與模糊柔光，表情只靠字重、2px 描邊、硬陰影與微傾斜。
keyCharacteristics: 奶油紙底＋墨棕粗邊＋鍋湯深紅，誠實、好讀
硬陰影 2/4/6px 為唯一深度語言
Noto Sans TC 400/700/900 單一字體
微傾斜徽章作貼紙感，不犧牲可讀性

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: 紅只說可點、重要、或現在，不要第二口音色。

rules.name: The Weight-Only Rule
rules.body: 不引入第二字體，層次只靠 400/700/900 與大小區分。

rules.name: The Hard-Shadow Rule
rules.body: 陰影只用實色偏移，不用 blur。

dos: Do 用 900 字重與硬陰影說話，保留 Noto Sans TC 400/700/900。
Do 價格只寫在菜單頁 td.price 文字，首頁只寫摘要。
donts: Don't 用模糊陰影、漸層或第二口音色稀釋鍋湯深紅。
Don't 編品牌故事、寫招牌、評分或自創品名。
